successCriteria.description: The SQL column reference in `findByEmployeeAndPolicy` is corrected from `policy_id` to `leave_policy_id` in the repository implementation.
The `findByEmployeeAndPolicy` method signature in `ILeaveBalanceRepository` interface gains a third parameter `fiscalYear: number`.
The `findByEmployeeAndPolicy` implementation uses `fiscalYear` in the SQL WHERE clause: `WHERE employee_id = $1 AND leave_policy_id = $2 AND fiscal_year = $3`.

All unit tests for `findByEmployeeAndPolicy` in `tests/unit/modules/leave/leave-balance.repository.test.ts` are updated to pass `fiscalYear` as a third argument and assert the corrected SQL with `leave_policy_id` and `fiscal_year`.
TypeScript compilation passes with `tsc --noEmit` and all existing tests continue to pass after the changes.

constraints: The database column name is `leave_policy_id` per ARCHITECTURE.md — the SQL in `findByEmployeeAndPolicy` must use `leave_policy_id`, not `policy_id`.

The `leave_balance` table has a unique constraint on `(employee_id, leave_policy_id, fiscal_year)` — `findByEmployeeAndPolicy` must include `fiscal_year` in the WHERE clause to guarantee a single row.
All database access must go through the repository pattern (GP-001).
The `LeaveBalance` model field `policyId` is unchanged — only the SQL column mapping in the repository changes.
outOfScope: Correcting `policy_id` → `leave_policy_id` in other repository methods (`create`, `update`, `upsert`) — the intent scopes the column-name correction to `findByEmployeeAndPolicy` only.
Changes to the `LeaveBalance` model interface — `policyId` and `fiscalYear` fields already exist and are not modified.
Changes to any other repository (e.g., `leave-request.repository.ts`) that also references `leave_policy_id`.

ambiguities.description: The `create`, `update`, and `upsert` methods in `LeaveBalanceRepository` also use `policy_id` in their SQL (not `leave_policy_id`). The intent only corrects `findByEmployeeAndPolicy`. If the database column is truly `leave_policy_id`, those other methods will fail at runtime. This may be intentional deferral or an oversight.
options: Also correct policy_id → leave_policy_id in create, update, and upsert SQL in this phase
